reason: Evidence shows this is a DeepSeek Harness dsh plugin that focuses on user interface customization, with theme styling, embedded fonts, animations, and a themed tab session-switcher interface. The package declares web client injection and the readme repeatedly describes aesthetic behavior, while no external service integration, data handling, or automation/test tooling capabilities are documented.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的主题插件，提供 Cyberpunk 2077 风格的霓虹外观、字体与界面动画，并支持标签页会话切换等视觉交互体验。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web UI theme plugin that applies a Cyberpunk 2077 neon visual style with custom fonts and animations, including themed tab-based session switching interactions.

capabilities: Applies a custom visual theme to the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Injects client-side assets/styles for neon/animated interface effects
Adds a tab-based session switching UI interaction
